cards.factual_pattern: NVOS_OBJECT -> CATEGORY -> KER_DUTY -> KER_EFFECTIVE_DATE -> ACTUAL_OPERATION_PERIOD -> IMPACT_BASE -> APPLICABLE_RATE -> COEFFICIENT_BY_PERIOD -> DECLARATION -> RPN_CONTROL -> ARREARS
cards.risk: Annual fee calculation may be understated if the reporting year is not split by periods before and after KER became effective.
cards.evidence_court_practice: RPN reported on 2026-09-29 that Glacem, a category I facility, omitted the increased coefficient for operation without KER from Jan 1 to Feb 24 and paid more than RUB 1.8m after control. RPN also reported on 2026-03-24 a court-backed recovery of more than RUB 59m from Ecoservice after incorrect declarations for 2022-2023.
cards.mirlex_checks: Object category; KER duty; KER effective date; periods of operation without KER; actual payment base by period; rates and coefficients; declaration arithmetic; reconciliation with PEC and permits.
cards.impact: Add permit-status timeline control to MIRLEX NVOS audit and future account. Link NVOS registration service to KER and fee lifecycle.
cards.red_flag: Category I object operated for any part of the reporting year without required KER while the declaration used one coefficient for the whole year.
